QuestInfo.name: Mr. Lim and the Subway
QuestInfo.0: #eJake#k, who works at the #eKerning City Subway Turnstile#k, wants to ask you for a favor. You'd better go talk to him.\r\n#bTip - At the entrance of the subway station in Kerning City, you'll see Shumi sitting outside.
QuestInfo.1: Jake at the Kerning City Subway Station needs help. Up north, there's a #e#bSubway Station that is only partially built. Apparently, the place is infested with monsters and construction had to be halted. #e#bMr. Lim#k#n has been sent there to assess the damage, and Jake wants you to go there to see how bad the damage is.\r\nYou should head over to the #e#bKerning City Abandoned Construction Site#k#n and find the Subway Station that's under construction, then locate Mr. Lim.
QuestInfo.2: Jake, who works at the Kerning City subway station, requested that you meet Mr. Lim at the Construction Site North of Kerning City. Mr. Lim then pleaded with you to check out the old subway platforms for him.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: You talked to #bMr. Lim#k inside the #bAbandoned Subway Train#k located at the Construction Site North of Kerning City.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. I called you here because I had a favor to ask. Since you've gone on many adventures before, you might have already been to this place... Have you ever been to the #bKerning City's Abandoned Construction Site#k?
0.1: There's an old station building that has ceased construction. Lately, I have received reports that a flurry of monsters have been roaming around the area. #e#bMr. Lim#k#n was sent there to assess the damage, but he just sent word that he needs another person to help and requests that I send someone dependable.
0.2: #b#h0##k, you're the most dependable person I know here, so I'd like for you to go and see what's going on. Will you help me?

yes.0:
Thank you so much for agreeing to do this without any hesitation. Please head east from Kerning City and follow the path to the #bAbandoned Construction Site#k.

The construction site is a huge area, but you'll be able to find an entrance to the #bAbandoned Subway Station#k somewhere. Please tell Mr. Lim that I sent you.

no.0: You must be busy helping someone else. That's too bad, because I can't think of anyone else who could do this job.

1.0: Only authorized personnel beyond this point! The area is still under construction, and it's very dangerous.\r\n#b#L0#I'm #h0#, and Jake sent me here to help you.#l\n#k
1.1: Jake sent you? Then you're here to help me investigate the platform, right? Awesome! I've been waiting for you. Now I can breathe a sigh of relief. It's nearly impossible for me to investigate this huge platform by myself.

yes.0: Anyway, I'd like for you to stop by every now and then and see if anything's going on. Once you've successfully done that, I'll give you #b#t4001321##k as a reward. Train 999 is the area where you'll find a number of special Bubblings. Those Bubblings tend to gather up shiny, useful items, which means you might be able to get some of them through drops. I'll be seeing you often here. Good luck!
